title: VPC Guardian scripts, OTA upgrade guards, and incident runbook for common private healthcheck failures
creator: Riley Chen
description: Purpose: Provide a single-source incident runbook and a set of idempotent Terraform/operational scripts (the "VPC Guardian") to detect, triage, and automatically mitigate the top 6 recurring Private (VPC) healthcheck failures we see in staging and early-customer deployments. Scope: detection rules, minimal safe automated actions, upgrade guardrails, post-remediation smoke tests, and clear escalation boundaries for human operators. This ticket covers: 1) runbook prose and playbook snippets for run-to-completion automation; 2) a Terraform module template (redwood_private_guardian) with hooks for post-apply verification; 3) OTA/upgrade guard logic (pre-checks, canary windows, rollback triggers); 4) integration points with Console alerts and the incident channel.
failure_modes: Control-plane node failing health probes (agent timeout / KV cache cold)
Intermittent egress (NAT) failures causing model downloads/timeouts
Security group drift blocking inter-pod traffic after IaC drift
Certificate rotation failures (expired certs cause TLS handshake errors)
Kernel/driver mismatches after on-prem node upgrades
Disk pressure / pod eviction storms on private nodes
detection_and_alerting: Metric-based: probe_fail_rate > 5% over 3m or probe_latency_p95 > 800ms triggers alert. Log-based: TLS handshake errors spike > 50 entries/5m. Healthcheck probes: /_healthz, /_kv/status, and control-plane ping. Console dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/private-health (staging link). Alerts should include instance IDs, recent terraform commit SHA, and active release channel.
automated_remediation_strategy: Design principle: automated actions must be minimal, reversible, and observable. Each remediation step has a safety guard (quick smoke test) and an abort window (default 10 minutes) that requires human approval to continue. Primary actions: - targeted terraform apply for security-group fixes (apply only delta with plan check). - restart agent service on affected nodes via remote-exec or SSM command. - reattach/replace NAT gateway if cloud-reported unhealthy. - trigger cert rotation workflow if rotation failed (dry-run then apply). - cordon+drain -> recreate node with preserved metadata for kernel/driver fixes. For upgrade-induced regressions: run canary subset first (5% capacity), collect regression metrics for the canary window (15m), auto-rollback if error budget exceeded.
terraform_module_notes: Add redwood_private_guardian module with these outputs/inputs: - input: allowed_rollback_window_minutes, canary_ratio, allowed_probe_failure_thresholds - input: remediation_policy (none|auto|manual) per failure-mode - output: webhook_url for post-apply smoke-run results - implement as reusable module that wires into existing private VPC modules using a null_resource 'guardian_trigger' with local-exec to call guardian controller. Avoid granting broad IAM privileges; use least-privilege SSM role for agent restarts. Store module in infra/terraform/modules/private-guardian.
playbook_snippets:
# force a safe restart via SSM (example AWS)
aws ssm send-command --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --targets '[{"Key":"InstanceIds","Values":["i-0abcd1234"]}]' --parameters '{"commands":["sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent"]}'

# terraform plan/apply incremental (use workspace)
cd infra/private && terraform workspace select staging && terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan && terraform apply plan.tfplan

# run smoke tests post-remediation
curl -sS https://private-agent-01._redwood_internal/ping || echo 'smoke failed'

# rollback example: revert last terraform commit and apply
git revert <last-apply-commit> && terraform apply
postmortem_and_escalation: If automated remediation fails twice within a 24h window for the same node group, open an incident and tag oncall-sre + private-deployments. Postmortem must include: timeline, terraform diff, guard outputs, smoke-test artifacts, and customer impact summary. Escalate to engineering lead and product for any data-loss or SLA breach.
testing_plan: 1) Unit tests for Terraform module (terratest). 2) Integration smoke-run in staging: seed failures for each mode using failure-injection harness. 3) Canary rollout: enable auto remediation for a single customer in staging for 48h. 4) Security review & IAM audit before prod flip.
